about: Spatial air traffic control for on-screen HUDs. Every HUD gets a reserved slot that never moves at runtime, so one HUD resizing can't push its neighbours. The slot is the default spot: HUDs Matt drags/resizes remember his frame in hud_positions.json (hud-kit HUDWindow), which then wins. dx/dy = distance from the slot's corner to the screen edges (visible frame, menu bar excluded); w/h = the most space the HUD may ever use. screen: builtin (laptop, else Sidecar/iPad, else primary), primary (menu-bar screen), cursor (screen under the mouse). Check for overlaps: hs -c 'return require("modules.hud_layout").report()' or lua tests/hud_layout_test.lua. Read by Hammerspoon (modules/hud_layout.lua) and TrackpadMixer (~/projects/hud-kit/Sources/Slots.swift).

claude_control_light.owner: modules/claude_control.lua (light tier pill: claude-control ask --light; top right per Matt 2026-10-22)

claude_notify.owner: modules/claude_notify.lua (below the control pill; 4 chips x 92px reserved; laptop-only caps at 4 (tweak chips.maxLaptop), more only with a second screen)

otp_code.owner: modules/otp_copy.lua (2FA code pill, fades after 12 s)

wifi_home.owner: modules/wifi_home.lua (Wi-Fi → home note after rejoining home, fades)

exempt.claude_control: full tier only: centre banner + edge glow while an agent holds keyboard/mouse; modal, meant to cover everything (light tier uses the claude_control_light slot)
exempt.hs.alert: centre toasts from various modules: transient
exempt.lecture_mode: exit button while lecture mode is on: modal
exempt.tweaks_panel: ⌃⌥⌘T Tweaks panel: a standard titled window, user-placed, frame remembered
exempt.palette: ⌥Space search palette (~/projects/claude-palette): on-demand, centred upper third, user-placed via hud-kit HUDWindow, frame remembered
exempt.gif_picker: ⌃⌥⌘G GIF picker: a standard titled window, user-placed, frame remembered
exempt.quote_comment: queued-count pill anchored to Claude's window above its message box, not a screen corner
